description: This is a PHP class defining a custom Logger that extends Monolog's Logger class, with additional behavior for handling debug mode and exceptions during log recording.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A custom logger class extending Monolog's Logger to add conditional log recording based on debug mode and handling specific runtime exceptions.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Overrides the parent addRecord method to conditionally log messages based on debug configuration, catching and handling RuntimeExceptions when not in debug mode.
